dishes.name: Golden Honey Porridge
dishes.title: Creamy oats with honey and milk
dishes.method: Simmer the oats and milk in a small pan until creamy, then stir in the honey.
dishes.why: A warm, manageable breakfast for the household that fits the stovetop-only requirement.

dishes.name: Toasted Seed Butter Sourdough
dishes.title: Sourdough toast with sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Toast the sourdough in a dry pan or toaster and spread generously with the sunflower seed butter.
dishes.why: I have substituted sunflower seed butter for the requested pistachio butter because pistachio is a medical allergy for this household.

dishes.name: Cool Skyr and Seed Bowl
dishes.title: Skyr with sunflower seeds and honey
dishes.method: Spoon the skyr into a bowl, top with the seeds and a drizzle of honey.
dishes.why: A high-protein, lower-starch breakfast that avoids tree nuts and fennel entirely.

dishes.name: Zesty Chicken and Pea Rice
dishes.title: Poached chicken with lemon and pea rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and rice in a pan with a splash of water and the lemon juice until steaming.
dishes.why: A loud vegetable meal using bright peas, providing the fuel needed for a large lunch.

dishes.name: Hearty Zesty Chicken Rice
dishes.title: Large portion of lemon chicken and pea rice
dishes.method: Reheat the large chicken and rice portion in a pan with the lemon juice.
dishes.why: A larger share of both protein and starch to support Bertille's muscle gain goal.

dishes.name: Green-Heavy Chicken Bowl
dishes.title: Lemon chicken with extra peas and light rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and pea-heavy rice in a pan with the lemon juice.
dishes.why: Prioritises a full protein share and generous vegetables with less starch for Ysoline.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Cod and Crushed Roots
dishes.title: Seared cod with crushed potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Steam the beans for 4 minutes. Reheat the potatoes and fish in a pan with butter until warm.
dishes.why: A medium dinner that uses the stovetop to avoid the broken oven door.

dishes.name: Buttery Cod and Potato Mash
dishes.title: Large cod portion with extra crushed potatoes
dishes.method: Steam the beans. Reheat the large portions of fish and potatoes in a pan with butter.
dishes.why: Ensures Bertille gets a larger starch and protein share for muscle gain while keeping the meal warm.

dishes.name: Seared Cod with Garden Beans
dishes.title: Cod with generous green beans and light potatoes
dishes.method: Steam the large portion of beans. Reheat the fish and small potato portion in a pan with butter.
dishes.why: Honours Ysoline's preference for generous vegetables and smaller starch while avoiding fennel.

preparations.title: Poached lemon chicken breasts
preparations.method: Slice the chicken. Heat oil in a pan, sear the chicken briefly, then add a splash of water, cover, and steam-poach for 10 minutes until cooked through.

preparations.title: Savoury rice with garden peas
preparations.method: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes. Add the peas for the final 2 minutes, then drain.

preparations.title: Boiled and crushed potatoes
preparations.method: Chop potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water for 15-20 minutes until tender. Drain and lightly crush with a fork.

preparations.title: Pan-seared cod fillets
preparations.method: Season the fish. Heat oil in a pan and sear the cod for 3-4 minutes per side until opaque and flaky.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the potatoes boiling. While they cook, start the rice. Pan-sear the chicken and the fish in separate pans (or sequentially). Drain the rice and potatoes, crush the potatoes, and box everything into the named containers immediately.

member_portions.portion_note: A larger portion of protein and starch for every meal to support muscle gain.
